description: Add CRUD endpoints for user management: list users, create a user, and delete a user by ID
non_goals: Authentication or authorization — no auth middleware for these endpoints
User profile updates (PUT/PATCH) — only GET, POST, DELETE in scope
Database migrations beyond what's needed for a basic users table
Pagination, filtering, or sorting on the GET endpoint

userStories.title: GET /users endpoint returns all users
userStories.description: As an API consumer, I can retrieve a list of all users so that I can display or process user data.
acceptance_criteria: GET /users returns HTTP 200 with a JSON array of user objects
Each user object contains at least 'id', 'name', and 'email' fields
When no users exist, the endpoint returns an empty array []
A pytest test verifies the 200 response and JSON structure
ruff check passes with no errors

userStories.title: POST /users endpoint creates a new user
userStories.description: As an API consumer, I can create a new user by sending a JSON payload so that users can be added to the system.
acceptance_criteria: POST /users with a JSON body containing 'name' and 'email' creates a user and returns HTTP 201
The response body contains the created user object including its assigned 'id'
POST /users with missing required fields returns HTTP 400 with an error message
A newly created user appears in subsequent GET /users responses
A pytest test verifies successful creation (201) and validation failure (400)
ruff check passes with no errors

userStories.title: DELETE /users/:id endpoint removes a user
userStories.description: As an API consumer, I can delete a user by their ID so that users can be removed from the system.
acceptance_criteria: DELETE /users/<id> removes the user and returns HTTP 200 with a confirmation message
DELETE /users/<id> for a non-existent ID returns HTTP 404 with an error message
After deletion, the user no longer appears in GET /users responses
A pytest test verifies successful deletion (200) and not-found case (404)
ruff check passes with no errors
